analysis:
Both supplied units are base_text excerpts (lines 1274-2468) of provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Inference/Engine/EngineV2BridgeTests.swift. They contain unchanged tests for cancellation, capacity mapping, factory config, shared KV budget accounting, SSD staging and lookup receipts. The only change in this file is a head-side test addition around lines 807-839, which is outside the supplied base text. From the patch excerpt, it adds two tests: scopedMatchedSequence and translationCarriesStopScope. These cover EngineV2Bridge.matchedStopSequence with a stopStringScope for gpt-oss, and EngineV2Translation.cbv2Request propagating stopStringScope.

The diff touches test code only. It adds no production code path, no new attack surface, and no change to the prefix cache, SSD storage, attestation, or the coordinator-provider wire. The relevant retained threat T-041 (prefix cache, TB-007) is unaffected. The unchanged tests around budget and staging reservation still document the same release-on-all-paths behavior.

Limitation: the production implementations of ModelEOSPolicy.stopStringScope, EngineV2Bridge.matchedStopSequence(scope:) and EngineV2Translation.cbv2Request(stopStringScope:) are not in the supplied batch. Those production changes, likely in other files of this PR, should be reviewed for stop-string handling correctness. The scoped stop-sequence matching could affect output truncation and billing, but not confidentiality. No security regression can be established from these test-only changes.
